title: Mobile piece detail layout and contextual AI teacher
summary: Reworked the component dialog with a fixed header and footer, bounded content scrolling and AI teacher actions carrying the selected lesson context.

changes.detail: Dialog header/close button and AI action stay outside the scrolling body; opening resets body scroll and focuses close without scrolling. Reduced enlargement of tiny image regions.
AI explain, example, quiz and custom question actions open the existing authenticated AI Teacher conversation with component name, role, example and language.

Shared bridge validation rejects unknown component IDs, unsupported intents and empty/oversized questions. Prompts clarify that the generated illustration cannot identify real part numbers or hidden construction.

validation.name: Validation
validation.detail: Pending focused interaction tests, bridge checks, typecheck, lint and history. No live AI request, deployment or APK rebuild.
